newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end mixed, outlook remains cautious.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end mixed, outlook remains cautious.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed narrowly mixed with the widely anticipated rise in U.S. interest rates already factored into stock prices, dealers said.
The bolsa is seen opening soft with investors worried that volatility will continue on Wall Street despite the Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates by 0.25 percentage points, they said.
"People are taking a wait-and-see attitude. New York is likely to continue to be erratic for the next couple of weeks," said one dealer.
The 40-share index ended up 0.06 percent at 113.41 points.
The general index lost 0.05 percent to 5,267.1 points amid turnover of 12.7 billion pesos.
Traders said stocks were likely to move within a narrow range of 112-115 points in coming sessions as players continue to buy selectively.

Decliners included power generator Chilgener which dropped more than two percent as investors bet they will pick up stocks more cheaply when the company issues shares in May for a $500 million capital increase.
Chilgener shareholders approved the increase at a meeting Tuesday.
Other losers included steel-maker Cap, down one percent at 990 pesos and power utility Endesa which shed 0.97 percent to 254 pesos.
Winners included forestry firm Masisa, up 2.31 percent at 210 pesos and bottler Andina, which rose 2.4 percent to 2,560 pesos.
